feat: robust cross-tick watcher (pending tracking, nonce reconciliation) + private trailing stop

Codex-authored refactor, reviewed + validated. New watcher no longer hard re-sends
in-tick (double-broadcast risk); tracks pending txs by hash, reserves per-order
nonces, fee-bumps stuck txs, and reconciles missing receipts against canonical
vault state. Adds a private trailing stop-loss (ratchets on FLR high-watermark,
fires on a fixed % pullback) fully wired through the encrypted-policy path.

Verified live on real Coston2: settle tx 0xb0d158…d2cb (block 33018361),
OrderExecuted, orders(1)=EXECUTED — exercised the receipt-lag reconciliation
path the mock never hit. go/forge/vitest all green.

feat: FTSO watcher settles triggered orders + entrypoint wiring

Polls FLR/USD every 5s via a minimal hand-rolled binding (vault
FTSO_V2() + getFeedById), normalizes to 6 decimals, and for each open
order at-or-below trigger sends settle(orderId, trigger, 300) signed
by EXECUTOR_PRIVATE_KEY with SuggestGasPrice and 3x exponential
backoff; orders flip to executed only on a successful receipt. Wired
into cmd/main.go and cmd/docker/main.go behind CHAIN_URL /
VAULT_ADDRESS / EXECUTOR_PRIVATE_KEY env vars (StartExtension now
returns the extension instance for store access).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test: FTSO watcher — trigger comparison, normalization, settle retries on mocked chain client

receipts, gas-estimation failure, and context-cancelled shutdown.
